manifesto.title: If you want to discover the real Nicaragua,
manifesto.description: Thousands of travelers are part of the community that knows how to travel. Our responsibility is to teach you destinations around the world and accompany you during your experience.

ai.question: How does Kary's AI work?
ai.answer: Kary is our AI guide trained with local information from Nicaragua. It learns from your preferences and creates personalized itineraries based on real destinations, activities, and experiences.

price.question: How much does Momotombo cost?
price.answer: AI planning and exploring destinations is free. You only pay when you book activities or experiences, with no hidden fees.

booking.question: How do bookings work?
booking.answer: Book directly with verified local providers. Your payment stays secure until you complete the experience.

cancel.question: Can I cancel my booking?
cancel.answer: Yes, you can cancel according to each activity's policy. Most allow free cancellation up to 48 hours before.
